name: 22314 · Alexandria, VA
findings: ZIP 22314 (Alexandria) has 875 nonprofit organizations. 509 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 478 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22314 (Alexandria) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22314 (Alexandria) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 12.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
